name: smwmusic-rockfish-unreleased-wharf-surface
title: Rockfish (Unreleased) - Wharf (Surface)
description:
A cute little song of Rockfish's second dev log song.
This game was being developed by Pixel for the IOS, back in 2010, until it got cancelled in order to work on Gero Blaster. Later on, it finally got rebooted into Kero Blaster, in 2014.
This song's a surface variant, and more accurate version of this theme.

It does uses the KDL3 soundfont.

Original description by Pixel
Original:
pxtone のライブラリ化にハマって、ゲーム本編が停滞中..
Rockfish(仮) の BGM「波止場」置いときます。→
ライブラリ化が上手くいけば、もっと表現力を上げられる..
Rough translation:
I'm addicted to the library of pxtone, and the main game is stagnant ..
I will put the BGM "Wharf" of Rockfish (provisional). →
If the library is successful, you can improve your expressiveness ..
